goal: Prevent opaque runtime values from being silently mapped while allowing user-declared data extraction when metadata is sufficient.
contract_rules: Opaque runtime values must fail with an explicit unsupported-type error unless an extractor contract is supplied.
Extractor contracts must declare the source runtime type and the ordinary data family produced by extraction.
Extractor output must be ordinary data that is already supported by a mapper family.
Extractor contracts must define deterministic behavior for the same source state and configuration.
Extractor contracts must declare failure behavior for missing metadata, closed resources, unavailable state, and unsupported source values.
Raw pointers require size, element type, byte order when relevant, ownership/lifetime, and safe-read bounds before extraction.
Extractor contracts must not add third-party runtime dependencies to the core SDK.

required_failures.name: no_extractor
required_failures.condition: opaque value supplied without extractor contract

required_failures.name: missing_metadata
required_failures.condition: extractor contract omits required schema or pointer metadata

required_failures.name: non_deterministic_extractor
required_failures.condition: extractor cannot provide deterministic output for same source state and config

required_failures.name: unsupported_extractor_output
required_failures.condition: extractor emits a value outside the supported ordinary data families

minimal_contract_example.determinism_statement: Reads the same byte range from an immutable source buffer for the same pointer metadata.
